title: qcost-bench: measurement instrument and replication data for 'Pricing Incomparability in Quantum Cloud Computing'
description: Replication package for the MSc-by-Research thesis 'Pricing Incomparability in Quantum Cloud Computing' (University of Huddersfield): measurement instrument, raw quantum-hardware execution records, certified statistics, expenditure ledger, rate archive and figures. The examined snapshot is tag v1.0-thesis (commit 674629a); this archived version additionally carries the dated rate-page captures, corrected citation metadata, and the v1.2 cash correction: the redacted Azure invoice G182569155 (no promotional credit applied; paid personally) and a ledger reconciliation whose cash fields are derived from it. See CHANGELOG.md. See README.md for the offline reproduction guide.
